## I APPLICATION OF THIS PART

## Scope and interpretation

## 88.1

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (1) This Part contains rules about—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (a) TEO proceedings in the High Court; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (b) appeals to the Court of Appeal against an order of the High Court in such proceedings. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (2) In this Part—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (a) “the Act” means the Counter-Terrorism and Security Act 2015;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (b) “closed material” means any relevant material that the Secretary of State objects to disclosing to a relevant party on the grounds that disclosure is contrary to the public interest;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (c) “legal representative” is to be construed in accordance with paragraph 4(4)(b) of Schedule 3 to the Act;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (d) “TEO” means a temporary exclusion order (which has the same meaning as in section 2 of the Act);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (e) “open material” means any relevant material that the Secretary of State does not object to disclosing to a relevant party on the grounds that disclosure is contrary to the public interest;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (f) “relevant material” means the material described in paragraph 3(1)(a) to (c) of Schedule 3 to the Act;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (g) “relevant party” means any party to the proceedings other than the Secretary of State;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (h) “special advocate” means a person appointed under paragraph 10(1) of Schedule 3 to the Act;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (i) “TEO proceedings” has the same meaning as in paragraph 1 of Schedule 3 to the Act;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (j) “TEO subject” means an individual on whom the Secretary of State has imposed, or is proposing to impose, a TEO. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.1] (3) For the purposes of this Part, disclosure is contrary to the public interest if it is made contrary to the interests of national security, the international relations of the United Kingdom or the detection and prevention of crime, or in any other circumstances where disclosure is likely to harm the public interest. ## Modification to the overriding objective

## 88.2

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.2] (1) Where any of the rules in this Part applies, the overriding objective in Part 1, and so far as possible any other rule, must be read and given effect in a way which is compatible with the duty set out in paragraph (2). [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.2] (2) The court must ensure that information is not disclosed contrary to the public interest. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.2] (3) Subject to paragraph (2), the court must satisfy itself that the material available to it enables it properly to determine proceedings. ## Scope of this Section

## 88.3 This Section contains rules about—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.3 This Section contains rules about—] (a) applications under section 3(1)(b) of the Act (application for permission to impose a TEO);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.3 This Section contains rules about—] (b) references under paragraph 3(1) of Schedule 2 to the Act (reference of the imposition of measures imposed without permission); and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.3 This Section contains rules about—] (c) applications to the High Court under section 11 of the Act (applications to the court to review decisions of the Secretary of State relating to a TEO). ## Application for permission to impose a TEO

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Application for permission to impose a TEO] 88.4 An application under section 3(1)(b) of the Act for permission to impose a TEO must be made by the Secretary of State filing with the court—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Application for permission to impose a TEO] (a) a statement of reasons to support the application;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Application for permission to impose a TEO] (b) any relevant material of which the Secretary of State is aware at that stage; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Application for permission to impose a TEO] (c) any written submissions. ## Reference of TEO imposed without permission

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Reference of TEO imposed without permission] 88.5 A reference under paragraph 3(1) of Schedule 2 to the Act of the imposition of a TEO imposed without permission must be made by the Secretary of State filing with the court—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Reference of TEO imposed without permission] (a) a statement of reasons for imposing the TEO;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Reference of TEO imposed without permission] (b) any relevant material of which the Secretary of State is aware at that stage; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Reference of TEO imposed without permission] (c) any written submissions. ## Application for review under section 11 of the Act

## 88.6 Rules 88.7 to 88.14 apply to a review under section 11 of the Act. ## Applications (general) and modification of Part 8

## 88.7

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.7] (1) An application to the court to review a decision under section 11 of the Act (“a review application”) must be made pursuant to Part 8, as modified by this Part, and subject to paragraph (2). [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.7] (2) The following rules do not apply to a review application—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.7] (a) rule 8.1(3) (court may order claim to continue as if claimant had not used Part 8 procedure);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.7] (b) rule 8.2A (issue of claim form without naming defendants) 1 ;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.7] (c) rule 8.4 (consequence of not filing an acknowledgment of service);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.7] (d) rule 8.5 (filing and serving written evidence);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.7] (e) rule 8.6 (evidence – general); and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.7] (f) rule 8.8 (defendant objects to use of Part 8). ## Review application

## 88.8

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (1) A review application must be started by a claim form. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (2) The claim form must set out—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (a) the details of the decision which it is sought to review;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (b) details of how the TEO subject is affected by the TEO; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (c) the grounds on which the TEO subject seeks to review the decision. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (3) The TEO subject must file with the claim form—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (a) a copy of—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (i) the written notice under section 4 of the Act of the imposition of the TEO; or

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (ii) where relevant, any notice under section 9 of the Act imposing any or all of the permitted conditions; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.8] (b) any evidence, including witness statements, on which the TEO subject relies at that stage. ## Fixing of directions hearing date

## 88.9

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.9] (1) When the court issues the claim form it must fix a date for a directions hearing. (2) Unless the court directs otherwise, the directions hearing will be not less than 14 days but not more than 28 days after the date of issue of the claim form. ## Service of the claim form and accompanying documents

## 88.10 The court must—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.10 The court must—] (a) serve on the Secretary of State and any special advocate (if one has been appointed)—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.10 The court must—] (i) the claim form; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.10 The court must—] (ii) the documents specified in rule 88.8(3); and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.10 The court must—] (b) send to all parties and to any special advocate a notice of the directions hearing date (where such date is not endorsed on the claim form). ## Acknowledgment of service

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Acknowledgment of service] 88.11 Where a special advocate has been appointed, the Secretary of State must serve on that special advocate a copy of the acknowledgment of service filed under rule 8.3. ## Directions hearing

## 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (a) for the holding of a further hearing to determine the application;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (b) fixing a date, time and place for the further hearing at which the parties, their legal representatives (if any) and any special advocate can be present; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (c) as to the order in which, and the time within which, the following are to be filed and served—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (i) any response to the application to be filed and served by the Secretary of State under rule 88.13(1), (2) and (4);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (ii) any application to be made under rule 88.13(5);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (iii) any information to be filed and served by the Secretary of State pursuant to an order under rule 88.13(7);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (iv) any evidence to be filed and served by the TEO subject under rule 88.14(1);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (v) any evidence to be filed and served by the Secretary of State under rule 88.14(2);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (vi) any application by the Secretary of State under rule 88.13(3), 88.13(8) or 88.14(3); and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.12 At the directions hearing the court may give case management directions, in particular—] (vii) any further evidence, including witness statements, written submissions or skeleton arguments, to be filed and served by the parties and any special advocate. ## Response by the Secretary of State

## 88.13

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (1) Where the Secretary of State intends to oppose the exercise of any of the court’s powers under section 11(3) or (5) of the Act, the Secretary of State must file with the court—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (a) the grounds for opposing the exercise of those powers; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (b) any relevant evidence of which the Secretary of State is aware at that stage. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (2) Unless the Secretary of State objects to the grounds and evidence referred to in paragraph (1) being disclosed to the TEO subject and the TEO subject’s legal representative, the Secretary of State must serve a copy of the grounds and evidence on the TEO subject at the same time as filing them. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (3) Where the Secretary of State objects to the grounds and evidence referred to in paragraph (1) being disclosed to the TEO subject and the TEO subject’s legal representative, the Secretary of State must make an application in accordance with rule 88.27. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (4) Where a special advocate has been appointed, the Secretary of State must serve on the special advocate a copy of the grounds and evidence filed under paragraph (1). [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (5) The TEO subject and any special advocate may apply to the court for an order directing the Secretary of State to file and serve further information about the Secretary of State’s grounds filed under paragraph (1)(a). [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (6) An application under paragraph (5) must set out—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (a) what information is sought; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (b) why the information sought is necessary for the determination of the review application. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (7) The court may make an order on an application under paragraph (5) where it considers that the information sought—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (a) is necessary for the determination of the review application; and (b) may be provided without disproportionate cost, time or effort. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.13] (8) Where the Secretary of State objects to serving on the TEO subject and the TEO subject’s legal representative the information sought under paragraph (5), the Secretary of State must make an application in accordance with rule 88.27. ## Filing and service of evidence

## 88.14

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.14] (1) Where the TEO subject wishes to rely on evidence in support of the review application and—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.14] (a) such evidence was not filed with the court with the claim form; or

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.14] (b) such evidence was filed with the court with the claim form but the TEO subject wishes to rely on further evidence,

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.14] the TEO subject must file and serve that evidence, including any witness statement, on the Secretary of State and any special advocate. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.14] (2) Where the TEO subject serves evidence in support of the application, the Secretary of State must file and serve, subject to paragraph (3), any further evidence, including any witness statement, on the TEO subject and any special advocate. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.14] (3) Where the Secretary of State wishes to withhold disclosure of any closed material from the TEO subject and the TEO subject’s legal representative, the Secretary of State must make an application in accordance with rule 88.27. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.14] (4) The Secretary of State must serve any closed material on the special advocate. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.14] (5) The parties and, where relevant, any special advocate must file and serve any further evidence, including witness statements, written submissions or skeleton arguments, as directed by the court. ## III APPEALS TO THE COURT OF APPEAL

## Modification of Part 52 (appeals)

## 88.15

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.15] (1) Part 52 (appeals) applies to an appeal to the Court of Appeal against an order of the High Court in TEO proceedings subject to—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.15] (a) rule 88.2;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.15] (b) the rules in Section IV of this Part; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.15] (c) paragraphs (2) and (3) of this rule. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.15] (2) The following rules do not apply to appeals to the Court of Appeal—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.15] (a) rule 52.12(1) (appellant’s notice); and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.15] (b) rule 52.13 (respondent’s notice). [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.15] (3) Rule 52.2 (all parties to comply with Practice Directions 52A to 52E) applies, but the parties are not required to comply with paragraphs 3(3), 7.2 and 27 of Practice Direction 52C. ## IV GENERAL PROVISIONS

## Scope of this Section

## 88.16 This Section applies to

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.16 This Section applies to] (a) TEO proceedings in the High Court; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.16 This Section applies to] (b) appeals to the Court of Appeal against an order of the High Court in such proceedings. ## Address for filing proceedings

## 88.17

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.17] (1) Any TEO proceedings must be filed at the Administrative Court Office, Room C315, Royal Courts of Justice, Strand, London WC2A 2LL. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.17] (2) Any appeals to the Court of Appeal against an order of the High Court in TEO proceedings must be filed at the Civil Appeals Office, Room E307, Royal Courts of Justice, Strand, London WC2A 2LL. ## Applications for anonymity

## 88.18

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.18] (1) The TEO subject or the Secretary of State may apply for an order requiring anonymity for the TEO subject. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.18] (2) An application under paragraph (1) may be made at any time, irrespective of whether any TEO proceedings have been commenced. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.18] (3) An application may be made without notice to the other party. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.18] (4) The reference in this rule to an order requiring anonymity for the TEO subject is to be construed in accordance with paragraph 6(3) of Schedule 3 to the Act. ## Notification of hearings

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Notification of hearings] 88.19 Unless the court directs otherwise, it must serve notice of the date, time and place fixed for any hearing on—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Notification of hearings] (a) every party, whether or not entitled to attend that hearing; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > Notification of hearings] (b) if one has been appointed for the purposes of the hearing, the special advocate or those instructing the special advocate. ## Proceedings which must be determined at a hearing

## 88.20

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.20] (1) The following proceedings must be determined at a hearing—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.20] (a) a review application under section 11 of the Act (review of decisions relating to temporary exclusion orders);

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.20] (b) an appeal to the Court of Appeal from a decision or order of the High Court made in the proceedings mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) above; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.20] (c) a hearing under rule 88.28(2) (consideration of the Secretary of State’s objection or application. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.20] (2) Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply where—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.20] (a) the appeal is withdrawn by the appellant;

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.20] (b) the Court of Appeal allows the appeal with consent; or

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.20] (c) the Court of Appeal strikes out the appeal. ## Hearings in private

## 88.21

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.21] (1) If the court considers it necessary for any party and that party’s legal representative to be excluded from any hearing or part of a hearing in order to secure that information is not disclosed contrary to the public interest, it must—

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.21] (a) direct accordingly; and

[PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.21] (b) conduct the hearing, or that part of it from which that party and that party’s legal representative are excluded, in private but attended by a special advocate to represent the interests of the excluded party. [PART 88 – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE COUNTER-TERRORISM AND SECURITY ACT 2015 > 88.21] (2) The court may conduct a hearing or part of a hearing in private for any other good reason.
